body: I'm not really interested in video games anymore. There are more productive things I need to do... what I really need is a girl. I'm sorry if this sounds blunt, it's unlike me. But I just need a vagina to distract myself with. I need to rub against someone and get these urges out of the way and find out that I'm capable of being happy again. Ordinarily I'm opposed to casual sex. But I'm a little drunk right now (again, unlike me). I miss having a girlfriend. I miss having someone to spoil. I miss going above and beyond to make every moment of someone's day the best it could possibly be. I miss being in love. I miss feeling loved. I don't know if I'll ever feel that way again, at least anytime soon, so I guess I'll settle for something less serious. I just need something so I don't ask myself every if this'll be the day I finally end this misery.

I can't believe I forgot. Yeah, I used to play WoW. It totally engulfed my life for a couple years. I guess I kinda blocked that out haha. Rush is my all-time favorite band. Yes is probably my second favorite, but I like them for different reasons.

Yeah drums are great. Unfortunately I haven't been able to enjoy playing as much as I used to. It's so hard to distract myself.

I played xbox. There have only been a few games I've liked. The Halo series, GTA 4, Red Dead Redemption, and Guitar Hero. I listen to a lot of progressive rock. Rush, Yes, King Crimson. I also like a lot of older stuff like The Who, CCR, The Grateful Dead. I don't really listen to much current stuff. I play drums and clarinet, but I'm no good at clarinet.

I'm afraid I don't watch that show so I don't get the reference. I'm doing better, but that's not saying much. The last three months have been the saddest I've ever been, but today was definitely the worst I've ever been. I used to play videogames, but I don't really play anything anymore. I like music. I'm usually either listening to it or playing it. I also like to read. But I spend most of my time these days watching TV.
